say:1:1660013001:1.text: Once the final enemy is dealt with, you make your way back to the cabin. The storm has passed. Sunlight now warms the snow-covered roof.
say:1:1660013001:1.source_cn: 解决了最后的麻烦，你们回到了那座木屋。风雪已经完全停了...
say:1:1660013001:1.male: Once the final enemy is dealt with, you make your way back to the cabin. The storm has passed. Sunlight now warms the snow-covered roof.
say:1:1660013001:1.female: Once the final enemy is dealt with, you make your way back to the cabin. The storm has passed. Sunlight now warms the snow-covered roof.

say:2:1660013002:0.text: Kiran is waiting outside. As the door opens, Oxana steps out in her mended old dress, smiling.
say:2:1660013002:0.source_cn: 基里尔正等在门口。屋门开了，奥克萨娜穿着那身精心缝补过...

say:4:1660013003:0.text: When their eyes meet, they don't say a word. They simply look at each other, and that alone says everything.
say:4:1660013003:0.source_cn: 当她的目光与基里尔相遇时，两人都只是静静地看着对方，无...

say:7:1660013004:0.text: Looks like the sky cleared up. It's a good day... for a date. Let's go to my favorite flower field.
say:7:1660013004:0.source_cn: 天空放晴了呢，真是个难得的好天气。我们……去约会吧？去...

say:8:1660013005:0.text: I remember those little orange flowers... the nameless ones you loved so much. The wreath you gave me the day we met—it was made from them.
say:8:1660013005:0.source_cn: 我记得，你最喜欢花海中那种无名的橘色小花。第一次见你时...

say:9:1660013006:0.text: I bet it looks beautiful now, with the sunset.
say:9:1660013006:0.source_cn: 夕阳下的花海……一定会很美吧。

say:10:1660013007:0.text: Kiran turns to you and places the crystal into Frieren's hands, a silent gesture of gratitude.
say:10:1660013007:0.source_cn: 基里尔转向你们，将那枚魔晶交到芙莉莲手中，无声地表达了感谢。
say:10:1660013007:0.male: Kiran turns to you and places the crystal into Frieren's hands, a silent gesture of gratitude.
say:10:1660013007:0.female: Kiran turns to you and places the crystal into Frieren's hands, a silent gesture of gratitude.

say:11:1660013008:0.text: Then he carefully reaches for Oxana's hand, and together they start toward the flower field of legend.
say:11:1660013008:0.source_cn: 随后，他伸出手，小心翼翼地牵住了奥克萨娜，向着那片传说...
